title: Qualify S2 pipeline speed and rollout parity
doing: Propose baseline versus optimized collection/update pipelines at K1/K2/K3/K4,64envs and1536rawframes per env, three disposable updates per implementation/rate. Use only the512 consumed training seeds; restore identical model/Adam/RNG inputs, compare rollouts/gradients/counters and measure speed/memory. Discard learned weights. Exact registration and explicit approval are required; S1-only approval does not authorize S2.
expected: Python/model pipeline changes may improve end-to-end throughput without changing trajectories. A10x speedup is a target, not a prediction already measured; shared-memory copies, MPS contention or audit overhead may limit gains. Any parity or cap failure blocks scale.
